title: HBO to Launch in Japan via Amazon Prime
text: HBO to Launch in Japan via Amazon Prime variety.com – Largely absent from Japan until now, U.S. pay-TV giant HBO is to launch in Asia’s second largest market via Amazon Prime Video. The video streaming platform is an extension of the Amazon Prime home shopping and delivery membership scheme which launched last year in Japan. (Amazon Prime Instant Video was present in Japan from 2015.)
